description_en: Queries the details of a specified secure tunnel, including the device to which the secure tunnel belongs, creation time, ID, and connection status
description_zh: 查询单个安全隧道的详细信息，包括安全隧道的所属设备、创建时间、ID、连接状态等
name: QueryDeviceTunnel

parameters.help_en: The ID of the secure tunnel to query
parameters.name: tunnel_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. On the Overview page in the IoT Platform console, view the ID of the current instance.

<notice>
If an ID value is available, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no <props="intl"><ph>Overview page or </ph></props>ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

Data.description_en: The information about the secure tunnel returned if the call is successful
Data.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回安全隧道的信息

Description.description_en: The description of the secure tunnel
Description.example: 用于远程登录到摄像头。

DeviceConnState.description_en:
The connection status of the device. Valid values:

CONNECTED: Connected.
DISCONNECTED: Disconnected
DeviceConnState.description_zh:
设备端连接状态。

CONNECTED：已连接。
DISCONNECTED：未连接

IotId.description_en: The ID issued by IoT Platform for the device, which serves as the unique identifier of the device
IotId.description_zh: 物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，作为该设备的唯一标识符

ProductKey.description_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs

ProductName.description_en: The name of the product to which the device belongs

SourceConnState.description_en:
The connection status of the access end. Valid values:

CONNECTED: Connected.
DISCONNECTED: Disconnected
SourceConnState.description_zh:
访问端连接状态。

CONNECTED：已连接。
DISCONNECTED：未连接

TunnelId.description_en: The ID of the secure tunnel

TunnelState.description_en:
The status of the secure tunnel. Valid values:

OPEN: Open. The corresponding device can be accessed through the secure tunnel.
CLOSED: Closed. The corresponding device can no longer be accessed through the secure tunnel
TunnelState.description_zh:
安全隧道的状态。

OPEN：已打开，支持通过安全隧道访问对应设备。
CLOSED：已关闭，不支持通过安全隧道访问对应设备了

Udi.description_en: The custom information pushed to the device
Udi.description_zh: 推送给设备的自定义信息

UtcClosed.description_en: The UTC time when the secure tunnel was closed

UtcCreated.description_en: The UTC time when the secure tunnel was created

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.

true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
表示是否调用成功。

true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
